title: Machine learning index rules out acute myocardial infarction within 30 minutes
summary: The existing MI3 algorithm, using age, sex and high-sensitivity troponin I at 0 and 30 minutes, was applied to 529 emergency department patients, 42 (7.9%) of whom had acute myocardial infarction. At an index threshold of 3.13 it reached 100% sensitivity and ruled out 67% of patients at 30 minutes, with 30-day major adverse cardiac events of 0.6% in the low-risk group. This is a single urban emergency department.

evidence.tested: Rule-out performance and 30 to 45 day follow-up in 529 patients evaluated for possible AMI.
evidence.unknown: Single emergency department; algorithm developed elsewhere; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning index combining age, sex and troponin to estimate myocardial infarction likelihood.
